newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen pushed up by bargain-hunters.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen pushed up by bargain-hunters.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise on buying by small and institutional investors looking for bargains after falls last week, brokers said.

"The market may continue its rally as both small and institutional investors are expected to make commitments," said broker Mahbub Morshed. Brokers said shares with good track records in the financial, leather and pharmaceutical sectors would be the most likely targets. The DSE benchmark index closed 16.81 points or 1.6 percent up at 1,062.22 on a turnover of 47.4 million taka on Thursday. It was closed on Friday for the Moslem weekend. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
